benchmark.intended_decision: Evaluate false-admission resistance, abstention behaviour and reconstruction-checker agreement for the IEAC runtime admission gate.
benchmark.purpose: Synthetic software admission-control benchmark. No industrial, physical, field, safety or production outcome is represented.

task.estimand: Per-failure-family false-admission rate and one-sided exact 95 percent binomial upper bound under the frozen synthetic mutation-generation law.
task.system_boundary: Rust IEAC runtime admission evaluator, static-only profile validation baseline, and reconstruction checker applied to one declared vertical's synthetic profile/request fixtures.
operating_conditions: One frozen synthetic qualification profile and operator profile pin
One synthetic request and measurement snapshot per generated trial
Single-fault, boundary and explicitly declared multi-fault mutations from the frozen 19-family panel.
D0 descriptive annotation only; no external actuation

Frozen 19-family panel: positive_control, exact_min_boundary, exact_max_boundary, stale_measurement, future_measurement, missing_measurement, duplicate_measurement, interval_crossing, out_of_range, just_below_min_boundary, just_above_max_boundary, unit_mismatch, identity_drift, profile_expired, profile_pin_revoked, source_revoked, authorization_unavailable, authority_escalation, stale_and_source_revoked.
SplitMix64-v1 PRNG; the single seed is frozen in replication.seeds and may not be overridden.
task.time_support: One admission decision per generated trial; timestamps are fixed or mutated within the frozen test contract.
task.spatial_support: One synthetic vertical fixture selected by benchmark.vertical; no real site or geographic claim.
task.output_contract: Per-trial disposition, reason codes, candidate/checker comparison, tamper result, latency and exact source identities.
known_exclusions: No real telemetry or data-rights assertion
No authenticated profile-pin or revocation authority signatures
No production authorization, safety case or SOTA comparison

datasets.license_or_basis: Synthetic fixtures maintained in this repository; no third-party or operational data.
datasets.notes: Placeholder content digest; replace with the digest of the exact frozen fixture bundle before a non-fixture run.

split_plan.split_semantics: Synthetic machine identities machine-a and machine-b are training groups; machine-c is the held-out test group. The split manifest is illustrative, not a real dataset split.

methods.name: Static profile-only validation baseline
methods.information_access_scope: Frozen qualification profile only; does not inspect runtime request or snapshot.

methods.name: IEAC runtime admission evaluator
methods.solver_or_runtime: Rust 2024 executable; runtime version and build digest must be recorded in the execution receipt.
methods.information_access_scope: Same frozen profile, profile pin, request, snapshot and authority fixture as the baseline plus runtime admission logic.

comparability.rationale: Synthetic contract fixture declares the same profile-only information and execution budget boundary. The static-only baseline is intentionally a weaker capability and is not a production comparator.

physical_resource_budgets.scope: Per method across the declared generated corpus.

budgets.equal_budget_policy: Candidate and baseline receive the same frozen manifest, profile fixtures and generated request set; seed, trial count and execution limit are fixed before the run.

metrics.name: False admissions
metrics.definition: Count of negative-control requests for which the candidate reports an admit disposition.
metrics.denominator: Negative-control trials in each failure-family and vertical stratum.

metrics.name: Candidate/checker disagreements
metrics.definition: Count of reports for which the reconstruction checker disagrees with the candidate on disposition or bound decision fields.
metrics.denominator: All generated trials in each stratum.

metrics.name: Admission plus checker p95 latency
metrics.definition: 95th percentile wall-clock latency for candidate evaluation and reconstruction checking.
metrics.denominator: One end-to-end candidate/checker evaluation per trial.

protected_constraints.scope: Every frozen negative failure-family stratum; no aggregate compensation.
protected_constraints.rationale: Synthetic software gate acceptance condition only; not a real-world risk guarantee.

replication.stopping_rule: Run the exact configured trials-per-family for every family; no early stopping or replacement after results are inspected.

environment.operating_system: Pinned CI runner; exact image identity to be recorded in the execution receipt.
environment.cpu: Exact runner CPU model to be recorded at execution.
environment.runtime: Rust stable; exact rustc and target triple to be recorded at execution.
environment.compiler_or_interpreter: rustc version to be recorded in execution receipt.
environment.notes: Synthetic contract fixture. Placeholder source and configuration digests are not evidence of an executed run.

recomputed_outputs: Profile, request, snapshot and authority digest bindings
planned_checks: Reconstruct each candidate report from frozen inputs
Check each reason-code expectation against the mutation family
Report candidate/checker disagreements by failure family
